description: This Java class 'DefaultOptionsConfig' implements the 'MongoDbConfig.OptionsConfig' interface, providing configuration options for MongoDB, specifically SSL enablement and read preference. It includes methods for instantiation from a Config object, equality checks, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultOptionsConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing MongoDbConfig.OptionsConfig, encapsulating MongoDB options such as SSL and read preference.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultOptionsConfig from a given Config object, using fallback configuration.

methods.name: isSslEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether SSL is enabled for MongoDB connection.

methods.name: readPreference
methods.description: Returns the read preference setting for MongoDB.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on sslEnabled property.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on sslEnabled.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object, indicating SSL status.
